inputs.prompt: Mina kneels amidst rows of rare, glowing moon-blooming orchids on a vast, terracotta rooftop at midnight. She wears a loose, sheer charcoal crop top that reveals the upper swell of her breasts and a short, structured skirt that ends at her knees, exposing the strong lines of her legs. Her hair is a striking platinum blonde, cut into a sharp, asymmetrical bob that frames her face. Her hands rest gently on a heavy ceramic pot, fingers stained with earth, her gaze fixed on a single flower with an air of serene, secret knowledge. The moonlight filters through the glass dome of the city below, creating a dappled pattern of silver and gold on her skin and the petals. There is a tangible warmth in the air, a sensory anchor of the petal scent filling the frame. The illustration style features soft, flowing ink strokes for her hair and skin, contrasting with the rigid, architectural lines of the rooftop, capturing a moment of peaceful, seductive stillness in an urban jungle.
